user: open youtube, twitter, and gmail in new tabs
content:
The user wants to open YouTube, Twitter, and Gmail in new tabs. I need to use the browser tools to open these URLs in new tabs.

Let me open them one by one:
1. YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/
2. Twitter - https://www.twitter.com/
3. Gmail - https://www.gmail.com/

I can use the `click` tool with CSS selectors or the `navigate` tool. For opening URLs in new tabs, `navigate` is the appropriate tool.

Let me use `navigate` for each URL.</think><|tool_call_start|>[navigate(url='https://www.youtube.com/'), navigate(url='https://www.twitter.com/'), navigate(url='https://www.gmail.com/')]<|tool_call_end|>
